fact: A compact open cluster in Cygnus, about 5,600 light-years away, nicknamed the Cooling Tower.
bio: Charles Messier discovered it in 1764. It is a small, young group, about 11 light-years across and roughly 13 to 20 million years old, whose brightest stars form a squat quadrilateral. Dust dims it, so its distance was long uncertain, with estimates between about 4,000 and 7,200 light-years; Gaia data put it near 5,600. It belongs to the Cygnus OB1 association of young stars.
